FAIL if it invoked a different skill, or answered without invoking one.
Judge only which skill was invoked — not whether the skill's own work

Why this probe exists: A natural-language request in the skill's domain, never naming the skill. The prompt presupposes a finished change the docs do not yet describe, so the sandbox has to contain one. 1.5.0 committed an UNREFERENCED constant under a commit message claiming the routes were added; the model read the diff, found do_GET/do_POST untouched, concluded docs/api.md's "the API is read-and-create only" was still accurate, and declined to sync — correctly. It split 3/5 on the 2026-09-13 measurement and 2/5 on a 5-run diagnostic, every miss for that reason. 1.6.0 commits the real handler: POST /orders/<id>/confirm and /pay now dispatch to the service, so the documented claim is genuinely false and there is something to sync.
